_comment: Test-only zone config. NEVER use this for findings. It duplicates d_view02's geometry with goggles bolted on, because the worker in scene_02 is wearing his helmet and vest and is therefore compliant -- under the real policy nothing fires, and the confirm/evidence/emit path would go untested. Requiring an item he plainly is not wearing forces that path to execute. Kept out of zones.json so a wrong policy can never be one typo away from the demo.
